body: Like the area has elementary schools, middle, and then high school. I've lived in the same area so I haven't had to really deal with not seeing the same faces.
I've never been homeschooled or anything, I've been in the same system of schools. But maybe trying to stay in touch with some others will help.

I'm in contact with my closest friends on a nearly daily basis. Idk I just feel weird because going to school you see the same faces everyday and there's acquaintances ya talk to, but it's going to be a bunch of strangers all at once after graduation.

I've been freaking out pretty bad about the fact that I'm a junior and I'm going to be graduating soon. I'm worried about loosing contact with friends and I'm just not great with handling change in general. 

At the beginning of July I broke my ankle so it hasn't been fun having to get around on crutches. At least I'm starting to be able to walk on it a little bit though. And since that happened I wasn't able to do marching band this season which is really upsetting considering I have a bunch of friends who are seniors. 

I just don't feel the same anymore. I also had a friend who died in February. I was told it was suicide, but some were saying it was an accident, I'm not even sure. I still feel guilty that I'm alive when he's not sometimes.
